name: The Oasis of Hollow Wells
summary: The greatest oasis of the Burning Sands and the southern terminus of the salt roads' western branch: a ring of deep wells around which the city of Hollow Wells grew. The water is older than any charter and colder than the sand has any right to allow.

geography.character: palm-ring basin, chain of stone wellheads, cistern-streets shaded in sailcloth

notable_sites.name: The Chain Wells
notable_sites.note: The innermost circle of wells, linked by an ancient chain-and-windlass system; drawing order is law.

lore_notes: 'Water comes from League wells' — the Well-League's councils and the caravan code bind carriage to water here, the arrangement that still holds.
Hollowborn names are taken from the oasis or the road; half the desert answers to 'Wells' or 'Stone' in some form.
adventure_hooks: A new well is sunk without League sanction and strikes something that sings back up the rope.
The windlass chain on the innermost well is found unlinked — impossible without hands.
